pins.definition: Not busy, occupied, or in use; available.
Of a person or time: not busy with work or duties; off.
Of a person or time: not busy; having no plans or tasks.

situation: A woman lies relaxed in a hammock slung between two trees in a sunny garden, an open book resting on her chest and her eyes closed with a small smile. A cold drink sits on a small wooden stool beside her, and her phone and laptop are left unused on a garden chair. Nothing is waiting for her.

prompt: A woman lies relaxed in a hammock slung between two trees in a sunny garden, an open book resting on her chest and her eyes closed with a small smile. A cold drink sits on a small wooden stool beside her, and her phone and laptop are left unused on a garden chair. Nothing is waiting for her. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
